note: Method lives in .claude/skills/consensus-guide/SKILL.md. This file records what is specific to Indian: the bodies worth checking, the two-axis facet, and what went wrong.

awardBodies.name: The Good Food Guide
awardBodies.note: Best Indian restaurants in London. 36 names recorded.

awardBodies.name: Michelin Guide
awardBodies.note: guide.michelin.com is permanently 403 to the fetcher. Read the 2026 column of the Wikipedia substitute in data/sources.json blocked.substitutes, but ATTRIBUTE to guide.michelin.com - filing it under en.wikipedia.org tiers the award B and loses the signal. 8 current Indian stars in 2026, Gymkhana on two. Rasoi, Tamarind and Vineet Bhatia are historic.

awardBodies.name: Asian Curry Awards
awardBodies.note: Winners are laid out as award CATEGORY lines - 'Asian Restaurant of the Year (London): Colonel Saab'. A naive scrape captures the category, often truncated mid-parenthesis. Extract the venue after the colon, drop the category, drop every non-London region. Cleaned 2026-08-30.

awardBodies.name: British Indian Good Food Guide
awardBodies.note: RESOLVED 2026-08-30. Was filed under a Time Out news article reporting the 2024 top 20. The guide publishes its own selection at /best-100-indian-restaurants-uk-british-indian-good-food-guide-2025/ (5 Nov 2025): 100 UK restaurants, 28 in the London section, 6 named London Icons.

editorialLists.name: Time Out
editorialLists.note: One masthead, one opinion. The BIGFG award has been re-attributed away from it.

facetAxis.note: Indian is two-dimensional, unlike pizza. A venue has a region AND a format, and the guide needs both axes - a Keralan cafe and a Keralan tasting menu are not substitutes for each other.

values.label: South Indian
values.describeAs: dosa, idli, rice and coconut rather than wheat and cream

values.label: Pakistani
values.note: Has its own topic and its own consensus file. Do not absorb it here.

values.label: Curry house
values.describeAs: the neighbourhood institution, often decades old

formatSection.title: Curry house or dining room
formatSection.note: The genuine split a reader needs and most guides blur: a 1970s Tooting curry house and a Mayfair tasting menu both get called 'best Indian' and are not the same trip. State which one each entry is.

cleanupRequired: None outstanding. The 2026-08-30 pass removed 55 award-category strings, 30 chrome names, 13 press-release headings and 10 non-London winners, extracted 6 real London winners from category lines, and added 22 aliases (Dishoom appeared seven ways).
knownGaps: Community tier (E) is still EMPTY. Two Apify Reddit runs on 2026-08-30 returned nothing usable - the first was not scoped to a subreddit and matched globally viral posts, the second was scoped to r/london but the search terms did not bind and returned meetup and supermarket threads. About $0.95 spent for zero citations. Reddit is also blocked to curl (returns HTML) and to the browser pane by policy. Needs a different approach before it is retried.
